about: The data EightPerDay stores, field by field, generated from the code (core.DataInventory). An aid for the record of processing activities and the information of the people concerned; no legal advice.

records.name: Employer
records.purpose: An employer, client or private work of a person, with how its time is tracked.
records.holder: The person; for a managed employer also the organization (Store.Managed). Records for every employer of a person count only for private employers.
records.deletion: Deleted by whoever may change the employer's settings; erased with the private part of a person (Store.Erase); records of a managed employer stay with the organization.

fields.name: owner
fields.purpose: The person the record belongs to.

fields.name: holder
fields.purpose: Private (the person's own records) or managed by an organization.

fields.name: mode
fields.purpose: How the time is tracked from the start.

fields.name: time_zone
fields.purpose: Time zone that decides the local date of a booking.

fields.name: week_start
fields.purpose: First day of the week for weekly totals.

fields.name: day_split
fields.purpose: Which day time past midnight counts for.

fields.name: standby_work
fields.purpose: Which standby counts as working time for the time account.

fields.name: archived
fields.purpose: Hidden from new bookings, kept for the past.

fields.name: hold
fields.purpose: Legal hold: stops the retention purge, for example during a dispute.

fields.purpose: Reason of the decision; always given for a rejection.

fields.name: proposal
fields.purpose: The values a change request asks the days of an approved period to hold: hours or an absence, and a note.

records.name: Organization
records.purpose: A body that manages the time tracking of its members.
records.holder: The organization and its administrators.
records.deletion: Kept until its administrators remove it; no erasure of a person reaches it.

fields.name: time_zone
fields.purpose: Default time zone for new members.

fields.name: region
fields.purpose: Default holiday region for new members.

fields.name: features
fields.purpose: Company features (approval, supervisor view), off by default, with the works agreement and who confirmed it when.

records.name: Membership
records.purpose: Ties a person to an organization for a period, with a role.
records.holder: The organization and its administrators.
records.deletion: Ended, never deleted; stays with the organization.

fields.name: employer_id
fields.purpose: The managed employer that holds the member's records.

fields.name: until
fields.purpose: Last day; empty while it lasts.

records.name: Timer
records.purpose: A running stopwatch: at most one per person, until it is stopped and booked as an entry.
records.holder: The person alone.
records.deletion: Removed when it is stopped, and with the private part of a person (Store.Erase).

fields.name: owner
fields.purpose: The person the record belongs to.

fields.name: employer_id
fields.purpose: The employer, client or private work the record is for; empty means every private employer.

fields.name: project_id
fields.purpose: The project the time will be booked on.

fields.name: note
fields.purpose: The person's note for the entry.

records.name: Access
records.purpose: The access log: who read, changed, exported or decided whose data when.
records.holder: The person concerned (their own log) and whoever runs the instance.
records.deletion: Only added; removed by the retention purge, never before two years.

fields.name: employer_id
fields.purpose: The employer, client or private work the record is for; empty means every private employer.

fields.name: action
fields.purpose: Read, change, export, decision or role change.

fields.name: what
fields.purpose: Which data, without the data itself.

fields.name: from
fields.purpose: First day of the data touched.

fields.name: to
fields.purpose: Last day of the data touched.

fields.name: prev
fields.purpose: Hash of the subject's entry before.
